statements.statement: The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The denial reason code is CO-50
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The study was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42
